description: This file defines the DataGroupPermission entity class for the OrangeHRM project, including properties and getters/setters for permissions and ORM mappings.

classes.name: DataGroupPermission
classes.description: Represents permissions for a data group associated with a user role, including read, create, update, delete, and self permissions, mapped with Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the permission record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the permission record.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.

methods.name: isSelf
methods.description: Returns whether the self permission is set.
